map.：面积 0.5 m²、镀层 10 μm、锌密度 7.14：m=0.5×0.001: : with an area of 0.5 m2, a 10 um coating and a zinc density of 7.14, m = 0.5 x 0.001 x 7.14 = 0.00357 kg, about 3.57 g.
map.：面积 A=1 m²、膜厚 h=50 μm、涂料密度 ρ=1.2 g/cm³：用: : with area A = 1 m2, film thickness h = 50 um and paint density rho = 1.2 g/cm3, usage m = A * h * rho = 1 x 0.005 x 1.2 = 0.006 kg = 6 g (one side). Both sides with 10% loss comes to about 13.2 g.
